summary: RETEST PASSED: The orphaned-ctx hydration bug from iteration_1 is FIXED. The pseudo-3D canvas upgrade now renders correctly during gameplay. After navigating Onboarding-close → TRY AS GUEST → GUEST tab → ENTER AS GUEST → start-sprint-btn → Skip orientation, the in-game state is reached (HUD shows PAUSE & RETIRE buttons, confirming playing=true). CanvasRenderingContext2D.getImageData() now returns non-zero RGB values at every sampled coordinate (was [0,0,0,0] in iteration_1). Sky band returns bright [79,188,240,255], horizon [44,53,71,255], mid-floor [35,40,62,255], near-floor [15,16,30,255] — clear depth banding present. Visual confirmation via full-viewport screenshot shows: tier-1 'cubicle farm' background with depth perspective, player figure on left running on the floor, obstacles ('Take Credit', 'Red Tape') with their cast shadows, two green pickup diamonds on the ground, and the perspective floor surface lit with a horizontal floor band. The fix at app.ts ~L2421 (re-acquire ctx in actuallyStartGame when canvas mismatches) + draw() ~L4712 self-healing ctx check is working — paints now hit the live on-screen canvas rather than an orphaned SSR-pre-hydration canvas.
action_items: Watercooler reply smoke-test was not executed in this iteration to keep the test budget focused on canvas verification (which was the primary deliverable). User indicated this was already confirmed manually so no action required unless changed since.

Optional: Address Canvas2D 'willReadFrequently' console warning if the in-app code path uses getImageData (this warning was emitted by my test sampling, not by app code — verify no app-side getImageData is hot-pathed).
critical_code_review_comments: app.ts is still 5648 lines — fix worked but the file size is still well above the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting runner-game (draw/update/gameLoop/spawn*), auth wiring, and quest logic into separate services or feature modules.

The self-healing ctx check at top of draw() is correct but defensive — would benefit from a single getter `getCtx()` that all 25+ canvasRef access sites go through, to prevent the same bug recurring if a developer adds new draw paths without the guard.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — canvas paints correctly, pseudo-3D scene visible, no JS errors

test_credentials: Guest mode (Firebase Anonymous Auth). Flow: Onboarding-close → TRY AS GUEST (login-gate-guest-btn) → GUEST tab → tick consent boxes → ENTER AS GUEST → wait ~10s for anonymous auth → start-sprint-btn → Skip orientation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Canvas paint verified. Auth flow is multi-step: (1) Onboarding splash auto-shows on every fresh visit even with localStorage flags — must dismiss via [data-testid='onboarding-close']. (2) Login gate requires [data-testid='login-gate-guest-btn']. (3) Then GUEST tab pill (button with exact text 'GUEST') → 3 consent checkboxes → button text 'ENTER AS GUEST'. (4) Anonymous auth takes 9-11s in this preview env. (5) Then [data-testid='start-sprint-btn'] → Skip orientation overlay (text 'Skip'). Once HUD shows 'PAUSE'+'RETIRE' you are in the playing state. Canvas dimensions are 1400x500 and it sits below the HUD row. Canvas samples at sky=(700,80), horizon=(700,200), floor_mid=(700,330), floor_near=(700,470) all return non-zero RGB confirming paint.
rca of the issue: Iteration_1 RCA was correct: ctx was bound to the SSR-pre-hydration canvas, all draws went to a detached node. Iteration_2 verifies that the applied fix (re-acquire ctx in actuallyStartGame() when this.ctx.canvas !== this.canvasRef.nativeElement, plus a per-frame self-heal in draw()) successfully redirects paint commands to the live on-screen canvas. Verified via getImageData (non-zero RGB at all 8 grid points) and visual screenshot showing the tier-1 cubicle background, player, obstacles with shadows, and perspective floor banding.
